cases.name: interpolation
cases.source:
import System.*

func Display(value: int) {
    Console.WriteLine("Value: $value")
    Console.WriteLine("${value}")
    Console.WriteLine("Value: " + value)
}

func Main() -> int {
    Display(42)
    Display(-2147483648)
    Display(2147483647)
    let absent: object? = null
    Console.WriteLine("Null: ${absent}")
    return 0
}
